armours.name: Prismatic Grace
effects: After reviving another player, grant them a Radiant Prism that blocks incoming damage for 5 seconds.
The first time you take lethal damage, gain a Radiant Prism that blocks incoming damage for 10 seconds.
While active, reviving another player fully restores both players but removes the Prism even at full danger.

armours.name: Tragic Echo
effects: Upon your first death, become a shadow clone that deals 100% increased damage for 15 seconds.

lanterns.name: Broadsides Lantern
lanterns.hold: Drop a bomb from above that explodes after 1 second. Deals 2750 damage and can interrupt Behemoths.

lanterns.name: Drask's Eye
lanterns.hold: Fires a lightning bolt in a direction that deals 400 Shock damage multiple times as it passes through enemies.

lanterns.name: Embermane's Rapture
lanterns.hold: Create a fire ball in front of you that explodes after 4 seconds, dealing 3250 Blaze damage to all nearby enemies.

lanterns.name: Koshai's Bloom
lanterns.hold: Dash in a direction, deal 2250 Terra damage to nearby enemies upon arrival, and gain 15% lifesteal for 10 seconds.

lanterns.name: Pangar's Shine
lanterns.hold: Create a frost pillar in front of you that deals 2500 Frost damage to nearby enemies over 10 seconds.

lanterns.name: Recruit's Lantern
lanterns.hold: Grants a 300 hit point shield that lasts 15 seconds.

lanterns.name: Shrike's Zeal
lanterns.hold: Creates an aura that grants nearby Slayers 15% increased move speed and attack speed for 10 seconds.

lanterns.name: Skarn's Defiance
lanterns.hold: Surrounds the slayer in swirling stone that deals 2500 Terra damage to nearby enemies for 10 seconds. Also generates 30 hit point shields per second that expire after 25 seconds. (Max 600 shields)

omnicells.name: Artificer
omnicells.passive: Amount of healing and shielding granted per second is increased by 1 for every 150 current health when activated.
omnicells.active:
Command: Your drone acts based on the target.
 1. Slayer: Remove negative status effects and grant Artificer Aura for 15s.
 2. Ground: Create a wall that blocks hostile projectiles and grants Artificer Aura to nearby Slayers for 15s.
 3. Behemoth: Make a part to take +15% damage for 15s.
 4. Downed Slayer: Revive and grant Artificer Aura for 15s (once every 90s).
 Artificer Aura: Restore 10 health/second. At full health, grants 10 Shields/second that last for 25s (maximum 400 Shields)
 Cooldown: 20s

omnicells.name: Bastion
omnicells.passive: Increase all shields received by 15%. Dealing damage has a chance to grant a stacking, refreshing 25 health shield that lasts for 25 seconds (max 500 shields).
omnicells.active: Leap forward and slam the ground consuming all shields in a blast of energy that deals damage to nearby targets equal to 200% the amount of shields consumed. 20 second cooldown.

omnicells.name: Discipline
omnicells.passive: Critical strike chance and damage increased by 8%. Healing is reduced by 50%. Reaching max stacks of Flaming Fist makes you Disciplined, increasing your critical strike chance by 50% for 40 seconds but increased damage received by 100%. When Disciplined ends, stacks are cleared.
omnicells.active: Perform a quick parrying punch that deals 200 blaze damage. Parrying an attack does +300% damage and grants a stack of Flaming Fist, giving +4% critical strike damage. This can stack 4 times. 17 second cooldown.

omnicells.name: Iceborne
omnicells.passive: Increase max health by 100. Gain 1% lifesteal and 5% reduced damage, then again for every 150 missing health. Taking damage reduces cooldown of the Active Ability by 5 seconds (only once every 5 seconds).
omnicells.active: Throw an ice lance that does 750 frost damage, double damage if thrown at full health. Also prevents you from being staggered and grants +10% lifesteal for 8 seconds. 60 second cooldown.

omnicells.name: Revenant
omnicells.passive: Lifesteal +2%. When Revenant state ends, each stack of Void Energy grants 115 health per second for 10 seconds.
omnicells.active: Drain up to 500 health to enter Revenant state and spawn a Void Orb. For every 100 health drained, summon an Umbral Tendril that deals 700 umbral damage. If an Umbral Tendril hits a target, it spawns an additional Void Orb upon impact. Picking up a Void Orb grants a stack of Void Energy, which gives +4% damage and extends Revenant state by 1 second. Revenant state lasts for 15 seconds and prevents all healing.

omnicells.name: Tempest
omnicells.passive: Attack speed +10%. Dodging through an attack grants a stack of Velocity. Each stack lasts 45 seconds and increases movement speed by 3%
omnicells.active: Consume a stack of Velocity to dash ahead and deal 450 shock damage to a nearby target, prioritizing unbroken behemoth parts. For every 1% increase in movement speed, deal +3% damage to unbroken parts. Stacks are refreshed on use. 6 second cooldown.

mods.name: Cyclonic Strikeplate
mods.effect: Tempest Form duration increased by 10 seconds. When Tempest Form has less than 10 seconds remaining, deal +15% damage.

mods.name: Echo Bracedriver
mods.effect: Critical strikes increase the damage dealt by Karma Breaker's damage over time by 10% until the debuff ends or is refreshed.

mods.name: Inertial Fistguard
mods.effect: Surge deals +25% damage. After surging, gain +5% movespeed for 8 seconds. Stacks up to 3 times.

specials.name: Adamant Bolt
specials.effect: Unleash energy in a focused blast, dealing 900 damage to the first enemy hit. Deals up to +100% damage when Tempest Form and Karma Breaker's effects are active.

specials.name: Titan's Crash
specials.effect: Unleash energy forward in a pressure wave, dealing 500 damage to the closest target and 166 damage to nearby target. Deals up to +100% damage when Tempest Form and Karma Breaker's effects are active.

mods.name: Furious Axecore
mods.effect: Perfectly charged attacks grants +15 meter on hit, but no longer grant resolve.

mods.name: Lightweight Haft
mods.effect: Movespeed while charging Horizontal Attacks is now increased instead of decreased and costs no stamina to maintain.

mods.name: Overcharged Cylinder
mods.effect: Determination can now stack up to 4 times.

mods.name: Railsplitter's Canteen
mods.effect: Tonics consumed while your axe is thrown have +50% effectiveness.

mods.name: Volatile Axecore
mods.effect: Charging attack deals aoe damage to nearby enemies at each charge level.

specials.name: Flight of Ruin
specials.effect: Throw the axe forward, damaging enemies while thrown. Reactivate to call the axe and perform a powerful overhand swing that can generate determination.

specials.name: Grim Onslaught
specials.effect: Throw the axe forward, damaging enemies in its path before landing a distance away. Hitting a Behemoth can generate Resolve and will bounce the axe back towards the user.

specials.name: Relentless Onslaught
specials.effect: Hurl the axe forward, damaging enemies in its path. Catch the axe to throw it again up to 2 more times in the next 5 seconds, dealing 500/600/1000 damage (further increased by determination). Does not build meter.

mods.name: Demolition Blades
mods.effect: Deal +50% damage to minions, fauna and objects created by Behemoths. On killing a minion, fauna, or object, gain 1 momentum.

mods.name: Hurricane Blades
mods.effect: Using Blade Spin grants stacking on-next hit damage that is consumed when using other attacks.

mods.name: Lightweight Chain
mods.effect: Increase the length of your chains by +25%. Your Chain Pull deals +25% damage and generates an additional 20 meter.

mods.name: Momentum Blades
mods.effect: After using a special, your next special use within 4 seconds is free.

mods.name: Serrated Blades
mods.effect: Bladed attacks have a chance to cause your next 4 lacerating attacks to deal +50% wound damage.

specials.name: Cruel Riftstrike
specials.effect: Teleport forward with invulnerability and strike the nearest Behemoth part, dealing 75 damage and applying a mark that deals 25 damage per second for 7 seconds. When a mark expires, it deals 200 damage for each other mark active at the time. Mark duration increased to 10 seconds if an attack is avoided during the teleport.

specials.name: Insatiable Dance
specials.effect: Push off a nearby target with invulnerability, then use primary or secondary attacks to perform a followup. Primary: A dash attack to the target that consumes 1 momentum. Secondary: A spinning slam that consumes all momentum to heal you and create a 150 healing orb for each momentum consumed. Targets at or healed to full health gain 5% damage for 10 seconds, stacking up to 4 times. (Consume 1 momentum if no follow up is performed.)

specials.name: Reaper's Dance
specials.effect: Push off a nearby target with invulnerability, then use primary or secondary attacks to perform a follow up. Primary: A dash attack to the target that consumes 1 momentum. Secondary: A spinning slam that consumes all momentum and deals greatly increased damage per momentum consumed. (Consume 1 momentum if no follow up is performed)

mods.name: Antique Clip
mods.effect: Ammo decreased to 2, but bonus from aethercharged ammo is increased by 300%.

mods.name: Extended Clip
mods.effect: Ammo increased to 6.

mods.name: Impulse Crown
mods.effect: Aerial Strike grants increased damage dealt for 10 seconds. Bonus is doubled if a Behemoth's head is struck.

mods.name: Turbine Trigger
mods.effect: Priming attacks increases attack speed by 10% until the combo ends. Stacks.

mods.name: Weighted Crown
mods.effect: Stagger damage is no longer halved when attacking Behemoth legs.

specials.name: Concussive Salvo
specials.effect: Loads ammo into the hammer before releasing, damage and interrupting behemoths.

specials.name: Ironheart Landbreaker
specials.effect: Hold to load ammo into the hammer. Release to create an aether vent that buffs players who step over it, granting them +40% damage reduction and up to 155 healing over 30 seconds when aethercharged.

specials.name: Mighty Landbreaker
specials.effect: Loads ammo into the hammer before releasing, creating an aether vent that buffs players.

chambers.name: Full-Bore Chamber
chambers.effect: Fires a piercing bolt in a line, dealing damage that falls as it travels. Empowered: Deals greatly increased damage and pushes the slayer backwards.

chambers.name: Marksman Chamber
chambers.effect: Fires a shot in a line, dealing 350 damage to the first Behemoth hit. If a part is struck, that part takes 25% more damage from Shots for 10 seconds. Empowered: Damage bonus increased to 60%, and 25% to all allies.

chambers.name: Salvo Chamber
chambers.effect: Fires an explosive missile in a line, dealing 450 damage in an area upon impact. Empowered: Fires 3 missiles in a spread.

grips.name: Captain's Grip
grips.effect: Launches a collectible buff a short distance, granting 15% increased attack speed for 15 seconds when collected. Empowered: Grants the same buff to all Slayers.

grips.name: Saboteur's Grip
grips.effect: Launches an explosive mine that deals 400 damage. Mine charges after a short period, increasing damage to 700. Empowered: Deals 900 damage when charged and can interrupt Behemoths.

mods.name: Capacitive Magazine
mods.effect: Using an ability returns 8 standard ammo to the magazine.

mods.name: Demolition Sights
mods.effect: While empowered, deal +100% damage to objects created by Behemoths.

mods.name: Extraction Catalyst
mods.effect: Reduce both ability cooldowns by 2 seconds when dodging through Behemoth attacks.

mods.name: Lightweight Frame
mods.effect: Gain 20% increased movespeed when at 6 or less ammo.

mods.name: Lucky Magazine
mods.effect: Grants 2% critical strike chance for each round missing from the magazine.

mods.name: Precision Sights
mods.effect: Deal 8 increased damage when attacking the same part multiple times. Stacks up to 5 times.

mods.name: Scoped Sights
mods.effect: Increases damage falloff range by 25%

mods.name: Tactician's Magazine
mods.effect: Empowered Reloading at exactly 0 ammo decreases the cooldown of both abilities by 4 seconds.

mods.name: Charged Swordfocus
mods.effect: Instead of dealing damage over time, Resounding Echo deals damage once after it expires and deals +35% total damage.

mods.name: Dynamic Bladecore
mods.effect: After using any Valour combo, your next Valour combo within 5 seconds deals +30% damage.

mods.name: Keen Edge
mods.effect: After dealing damage with the Bladesurge projectile, increase your movement speed by 25% for 10 seconds. Additionally, after the Bladesurge projectile travels a short distance, the damage is increased by 100%.

mods.name: Mending Bladecore
mods.effect: Each Valour gained or spent restores 30 health

mods.name: Recursive Hilt
mods.effect: Dealing damage with Bladerush restores 20 stamina and generates 3 Valour over 9 seconds. Does not stack.

specials.name: Ardent Cyclone
specials.effect: Activate at full meter to spin, dealing 70 damage constantly to nearby enemies. Grants 1 Valour every 4 seconds. Reactivate to slash in a direction, dealing 500 + (10 x number of spin hits) to the first enemy hit.

specials.name: Avenging Overdrive
specials.effect: Activate at full meter to enter Overdrive, gaining +20% attack speed and causing attacks to deal +60-80 aoe damage. Reactivate to parry and riposte a Behemoth attack, dealing 800 damage and granting 1 Valour when successful (2 second cooldown)

specials.name: Valiant Overdrive
specials.effect: Activate at full meter to enter Overdrive, gaining +20% attack speed and causing attacks to deal +60-80 aoe damage. Grants 1 Valour immediately and then 1 Valour every 4 seconds. Reactivate to dash in a direction (Costs 1 Valour).

mods.name: Balanced Spearhead
mods.effect: Increases damage dealt by 5% each time Piercing and Harvesting attacks are alternated. After the fifth alternating attack, increase damage dealt by 25% for 8 seconds. Resets upon combo end.

mods.name: Barbed Spearhead
mods.effect: After a dodge piercing attack, gain +50% wound damage for 8 seconds.

mods.name: Executioner's Spearhead
mods.effect: Each time you wound or assist wounding a Behemoth, gain 8% damage for 45 seconds. Stacks up to 5.

mods.name: Lightweight Shaft
mods.effect: Pike charge attack no longer costs stamina and always critically strikes.

mods.name: Munitions Amplifier
mods.effect: Stored ammo quality increases slowly over time, up to max. Stored ammo quality is also increased by an additional 25%.

specials.name: Concussive Payload
specials.effect: Press to convert meter into ammo. Hold to spend ammo to fire a missile that deals up to 1200 damage based on ammo quality and can interrupt Behemoths.

specials.name: Reckless Leap
specials.effect: Press to convert meter into ammo. Hold to spend ammo and perform a flying lunge attack that deals up to 1500 damage based on distance and ammo quality.

specials.name: Savage Wellspring
specials.effect: Press to convert meter into ammo. Hold to spend ammo to create an aura that buffs nearby allies with up to +30% critical strike chance based on ammo quality for 10 seconds.
